HSTG.description: Heat of Hydration Loads (HSTG). Defines a hydration analysis stage with an additional-step time list plus the structure/boundary/load groups activated or deactivated at this stage; Hydration Stage cannot coexist with Construction Stage in the same model.

bINITAL_TEMP.description: Whether the initial temperature (INITIAL_TEMP) is used for this stage.

INITIAL_TEMP.description: Initial temperature value applied when bINITAL_TEMP is true.

ADD_STEP.description: Additional analysis time steps (in days) for the hydration stage.

ACT_ELEM.description: Names of element (structure) groups activated at this stage.

ACT_BNGR.description: Names of boundary groups activated at this stage.

DACT_BNGR.description: Names of boundary groups deactivated at this stage.

ACT_LOAD.description: Load groups activated at this stage.

DAY.description: Activation day; special values "FIRST" (first day of stage) or "LAST" (last day of stage), otherwise a numeric day string (e.g. "10"). Defaults to "FIRST" if omitted.

DACT_LOAD.description: Load groups deactivated at this stage.

DAY.description: Deactivation day; special values "FIRST" (first day of stage) or "LAST" (last day of stage), otherwise a numeric day string (e.g. "80"). Defaults to "FIRST" if omitted.
